Location: 345 Greensborough Road, Watsonia, Victoria, 3087
Salary: $79,000 – $81,000 per annum + guaranteed superannuation

About the Company
Khanz Auto Hub is a trusted used car dealership and fleet management service provider with showrooms in Watsonia and Thomastown in Melbourne, Victoria. We specialize in high-quality used vehicles and customized fleet and rental solutions. At Khanz Auto Hub, we work hard to provide our customers with the best used vehicles and exceptional service they can rely on. We ensure our customers leave our dealerships with a vehicle that perfectly suits their lifestyle and budget. 
For fleet management solutions, we cater to both small and large businesses, offering cost-effective rental and management services designed to optimize fleet performance. 
At Khanz Auto Hub, we strive to provide the best used vehicles and reliable after-sales maintenance services, ensuring comprehensive support for our customers. 

Position Description
We are currently seeking a qualified and experienced Sales Performance Analyst to join our team at Khanz Auto Hub. The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in analysing sales performance data, inventory turnover, customer insights, and sales team metrics to drive data-informed decisions that optimise profitability, procurement, and overall business performance in our used vehicle dealership and fleet management operations.
The salary for this position ranges from $79,000 to $81,000 per year plus guaranteed superannuation, depending on qualifications, skills, and experience.

Key Duties and Responsibilities:
1.	Analyse sales transaction data across hundreds of annual vehicle sales to identify patterns in vehicle turnover rates, profitability by vehicle type/age/source, pricing effectiveness, seasonal demand variations, customer purchasing behavior, and margin performance to inform procurement and inventory decisions.
2.	Consolidate data from sales transactions, vehicle purchases, refurbishment expenses, and customer records into organized databases enabling analysis of profitability and sales performance patterns.
3.	Analyze inventory turnover by vehicle type, identify slow-moving vehicles, and recommend which vehicle categories to purchase more or less to improve capital efficiency and reduce holding costs.
4.	Analyze refurbishment costs versus sale prices to determine how much to invest in repairs and improvements for different vehicle types to maximize profit margins.
5.	Prepare performance reports and dashboards presenting which vehicles sell best, procurement recommendations, pricing strategies, and sales forecasts to inform business decisions.
6.	Compare different vehicle sources (auctions, wholesale, trade-ins, direct purchases) by analyzing profit margins and sales speed to determine optimal allocation of the annual procurement budget.
7.	Analyze customer data to identify buyer segments (individual, business, fleet), their vehicle preferences and purchasing patterns to guide inventory selection strategies.
8.	Track and analyze sales representative performance metrics including conversion rates, average sale prices, margin achievement, product mix effectiveness, and customer satisfaction to identify best practices, training needs, and performance improvement opportunities.

Essential Requirements:
•	At least a bachelor’s degree or higher qualification.
•	At least 1 year of full-time work experience.
•	Strong analytical and quantitative skills with advanced Excel and experience in dashboards (Power BI, Tableau) and database management.
•	Ability to interpret and communicate complex data to non-technical stakeholders.
•	Experience analysing sales metrics, product performance, customer trends and pricing structures.
•	High attention to detail, accuracy and ability to prioritise multiple tasks.
•	Experience working with ERP/CRM systems and integrating data from multiple sources.
•	Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work both independently and collaboratively.

Duration
Seasonal employment for up to 9 months, with the anticipated employment period being September 2026 to September 2027, subject to seasonal and operational requirements.

Successful applicants will be employed under the Horticulture Award 2020 and classified according to their skills, experience and duties performed.

Employees classified at Level 1 will undertake routine horticultural and general farm labour duties under supervision, including:
Planting melon crops.
Weeding and crop maintenance.
Harvesting, picking, grading and packing produce.
Loading and unloading produce.
Cleaning work areas and equipment.
Following workplace health and safety, food safety and quality assurance procedures.
General farm labouring duties as directed.

Level 2 – Casual: $33.05 per hour
Employees classified at Level 2 will perform all Level 1 duties and may also:
Work with a greater level of responsibility and minimal supervision.
Operate and monitor irrigation systems.
Perform crop monitoring and quality checks.
Operate basic farm machinery and equipment where trained and authorised.
Assist with packing line operations and maintaining productivity standards.
Support and assist in the training of new employees where required.
Perform additional duties consistent with a Level 2 classification.
Classification will be determined by the employer based on the employee's skills, experience and the duties performed.

About the Role
Successful applicants will assist with all aspects of melon production, including planting, crop maintenance, irrigation, harvesting, picking, packing and general farm duties. Work is performed outdoors in a fast-paced environment and requires a high level of physical fitness and stamina.

Applicants must be willing to work in varying weather conditions, including hot temperatures, and be capable of performing physically demanding and repetitive manual tasks.

Key Duties
Planting melon crops.
Weeding and crop maintenance.
Irrigation and field maintenance.
Harvesting melons.
Picking, grading and packing produce.
Loading and unloading produce.
General farm labouring duties.
Cleaning and maintaining work areas and equipment.
Following workplace health and safety, food safety and quality assurance procedures.
Any other duties as directed by the employer.

What to Expect
Early morning starts.
Outdoor work in varying weather conditions, including hot temperatures.
Physically demanding work.
Repetitive manual tasks.
Fast-paced work environment.
Flexible hours depending on seasonal and operational requirements.
Weekend and public holiday work may be required.
Essential Requirements

Applicants must:
Have a high level of physical fitness and stamina.
Be physically capable of standing, walking, bending, squatting, lifting and carrying produce for extended periods.
Be able to undertake repetitive manual labour throughout the workday.
Be willing to work outdoors in varying weather conditions.
Be reliable, punctual and have a strong work ethic.
Be able to follow instructions and work safely.
Be able to work independently and as part of a team.
Hold a valid right to work in Australia.
Previous horticultural experience is desirable but not essential, as full training will be provided.

Additional Information
This is physically demanding outdoor work. Applicants must be capable of working on their feet for extended periods while performing repetitive manual tasks, including bending, lifting, carrying, picking and packing produce. The role requires a high level of physical fitness and the ability to work efficiently in varying weather conditions throughout the season.

Job Title: Metallurgical Technician (Metallurgical or Materials Technician - ANZSCO 312912) 
Company: Scidell Pty Ltd, allied company of Multicom Resources Pty Ltd 
Location: St Elmo Site, Julia Creek QLD, Australia 
Employment Type: Permanent, Full-time 
Recruitment managed by: Yakr Pty Ltd

About the company:
Our client Scidell Pty Ltd is a scientific delivery alliancing company created to provide professional and cost-effective solutions to Multicom Resources Pty Ltd (Multicom). Scidell’s multi-disciplined scientific and technical project professionals operate from Brisbane and on-site to deliver major projects from initial study through to execution, commissioning, and ongoing expert operational support. 

Multicom is on a mission to bring high-purity critical minerals to the world and become a reliable supplier for global technology manufacturers. Currently, Multicom is progressing the permitting, approval, and development of its 100% owned Saint Elmo Project, situated 25 km east of Julia Creek in Queensland's Northwest Minerals Province , focused on advancing the production of critical assets like vanadium and high-purity alumina (HPA). 

About the role:
As a Metallurgical Technician at Scidell, you will be a key member of the production and operations team responsible for monitoring and improving metallurgical performance targets for the Saint Elmo refinery and mine facility. Working under the direct supervision of the Process Supervisor, you will test materials, operate equipment, and optimize processes to ensure safe, efficient plant operations. This role provides an outstanding opportunity to apply technical data analysis and hands-on testing skills within a highly sophisticated minerals processing environment. 

Key Responsibilities:
•	Process Optimization & Monitoring: Monitor various stages of the production process to ensure smooth operations. Check and adjust parameters such as temperature, pressure, flow rates, and chemical concentrations to maximize plant throughput, Vanadium/HPA recovery, and quality costs. 
•	Metallurgical Testing & Surveys: Undertake surveys, coordinate sampling activities, and execute test work to evaluate and identify process improvement opportunities. 
•	Equipment Operations: Start up, shut down, adjust, and operate plant machinery and equipment safely in strict accordance with standard operating procedures (SOPs). 
•	Equipment & Lab Performance: Monitor key equipment across both the process plant and the onsite laboratory to ensure components are optimized and alternative operational methods are assessed. 
•	Quality Control & Data Review: Conduct regular routine inspections and quality control checks on products and materials. Review operating and technical data to identify instances of noncompliance or opportunities for process optimization. 
•	Metallurgical Reporting: Maintain accurate records of equipment operations, process parameters, production, and testing activities. Generate precise metallurgical reconciliations and complete timely daily, weekly, and monthly reports. 
•	Troubleshooting & Technical Support: Identify and troubleshoot basic equipment issues, malfunctions, or process deviations. Provide expert technical support to operations, laboratory teams, and the senior process engineering team, collaborating closely on complex issues. 
•	Safety Compliance: Adhere strictly to the Site Safety and Health Management System and all established SOPs, ensuring all safety hazards or incidents are reported promptly. 

Key Requirements:
•	Education: Bachelor's degree in Extractive Metallurgy, Chemistry, or Chemical Engineering. 
•	Experience: Minimum of 5 years of experience in a similar metallurgical or materials testing role, with solid practical experience testing materials within a mineral/metal process and refinery environment. 
•	Licences: Possession of (or the immediate ability to acquire) a Radiation Safety Licence and a Queensland Driver’s Licence (manual preferred). 
•	Technical Skills: Sound understanding of process control systems , mechanical aptitude or a strong interest in hands-on technical roles , and a proven ability to source, gather, interpret, and communicate quantitative and qualitative data. 
•	Personal Attributes: Highly detail-oriented, safety-conscious, willing to learn, and possessing a reliable and consistent work ethic. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to follow technical instructions accurately. 
•	Pre-Employment Screening: Must be able to pass a comprehensive Pre-Employment Medical examination, including a drug and alcohol screen. 

Why join Scidell?
Scidell offers a unique opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge mineral processing projects while working in a supportive, cooperative, and collaborative environment. Be part of a dedicated team that values safety, high attention to detail, and innovation in delivering critical minerals to global markets. 

How to Apply: 
If you're ready to be part of a dynamic team at Scidell Pty Ltd, dedicated to innovation and excellence, we’d love to hear from you! Please submit your resume/CV, ensuring you highlight your relevant material testing, metallurgical data analysis, and engineering experiences. 

Scidell Pty Ltd is an equal-opportunity employer, committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds. While we appreciate every application, please note that only those selected for an interview will be contacted.
